findings.message: property package 'Peng-Robinson (PR)' is a substitution for Peng-Robinson with modified Huron-Vidal mixing rules (loses: the modified Huron-Vidal (excess Gibbs energy) mixing rules; classical one-fluid mixing with kij); accepted: The selection (Carlson tree) recommends PSRK or Peng-Robinson / RKS with modified Huron-Vidal mixing rules for a polar mixture at 43 bar(a) without interaction parameters; the DWSIM route runs none of them, and methods.yml names Peng-Robinson as the executable substitute of PR-MHV2 (it loses the excess-Gibbs-energy mixing rule). Used as in ammonia-1 for the same water-bearing synthesis gas. Proposed by the agent (D-015), not yet accepted by the owner or a reviewer (as of 2026-11-01): until then the maturity pass on the property package is not earned (D-015). PR rather than SRK: DWSIM's SRK has no kij even for the N2/O2/Ar pairs, PR carries DWSIM's database kij. Known weak spots, all outside the range core claims for PR (methods.yml: N2, O2, Ar only; the core issue on property qualification is open): water condensation and CO2 solubility at V-201 (313 K, 2950 kPa(a)) on DWSIM's own kij, and the enthalpy of steam at 4300 kPa(a) in the steam mixing M-102.
findings.hint: the substitution stays visible; review it with the property method
